goal: Make every applicable VGI SQLLogicTest execute and agree, adapting DuckDB syntax only where DataFusion has an equivalent semantic surface.

status_definitions.complete: All applicable records in this area pass or have an explicitly reviewed SQL adaptation.
status_definitions.partial: Useful functionality passes, but one or more applicable capability slices remain incomplete.
status_definitions.not_started: The VGI surface has no DataFusion integration yet.
status_definitions.blocked: Coverage requires credentials, services, containers, or another external fixture not present in the normal run.
status_definitions.out_of_scope: The assertion is specifically about DuckDB or its extension and has no DataFusion equivalent.

sql_policy: Run standard SQL and SQL accepted by DataFusion unchanged.
Adapt DuckDB syntax only when DataFusion exposes equivalent semantics; keep sparse, exact-SQL-guarded sidecars under corpus/overlays and trace every adaptation in the report.
Map typeof, duckdb_logs, and VGI diagnostics to existing DataFusion APIs when the adapter has equivalent state.
Mark DuckDB extension settings, PRAGMAs, unavailable duckdb_* metadata, and storage internals out_of_scope rather than treating them as adapter failures.
Do not adapt away a missing VGI protocol feature or a wrong result.
Expected-error statements are tracked but excluded from positive execution rates until error-contract comparison is implemented.
